text_elements.text: Power switch ON and wait for 10 seconds or more.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CAUTION: Never  bring  the  vehicle  into  the  READY  status  with  the  service  plug  removed  unless  otherwise instructed in the Service Manual. A malfunction may occur if this is not observed.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: 1.PERFORM THE SELF-DIAGNOSIS OF LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check to see if 'P3049'-'P3060' (CELL CONT ASIC VOLT related codes) or 'P3375'-'P33A4' (CELL OVER DISCHARGE related codes) is detected simultaneously with 'P308B'-'P3096'.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When  'P3049'-'P3054'  are  detected  simultaneously,  perform  the  diagnosis  procedure  of 'P3049'-'P3054'. Refer to EVB-94, "Diagnosis Procedure".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When  'P3055'-'P3060'  are  detected  simultaneously,  perform  the  diagnosis  procedure  of 'P3055'-'P3060'. Refer to EVB-96, "Diagnosis Procedure".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When  'P3375'-'P3380'  are  detected  simultaneously,  perform  the  diagnosis  procedure  of 'P3375'-'P3380'. Refer to EVB-135, "Diagnosis Procedure".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When  'P3381'-'P338C'  are  detected  simultaneously,  perform  the  diagnosis  procedure  of 'P3381'-'P338C'. Refer to EVB-139, "Diagnosis Procedure".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When  'P338D'-'P3398'  are  detected  simultaneously,  perform  the  diagnosis  procedure  of 'P338D'-'P3398'. Refer to EVB-143, "Diagnosis Procedure"
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When  'P3399'-'P33A4'  are  detected  simultaneously,  perform  the  diagnosis  procedure  of 'P3399'-'P33A4'. Refer to EVB-146, "Diagnosis Procedure".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: Disconnect high voltage. Refer to GI-33, "How to Disconnect High Voltage".
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-204, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check connection status of Li-ion battery controller harness connector and module harness connector.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 4.CHECK HARNESS BETWEEN LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER AND MODULE
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Disconnect Li-ion battery controller harness connector and voltage detection terminal of bus bar.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Refer to below table and continuity between Li-ion battery controller and voltage detection terminal of bus bar, according to detected DTC.
text_elements.label: list_item
